newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SVCD Portuguese PSI20 futures trade seen growing in 1997.
newsitem.headline: SVCD Portuguese PSI20 futures trade seen growing in 1997.

text.p: Trade in PSI20 futures, which got off to a slow start last June, is expected to grow in 1997 as the increased volatility of the Lisbon cash market will encourage investors, analysts said.
The PSI20 index groups 20 leading Portuguese shares.
"1997 will see new participants enter the PSI20 futures market, boosting liquidity," said Antonio Aranha of Lisbon broker Cisf Dealer.
"This will be the year when the futures market steers a path towards maturity," he added.

Foreign investors, who have largely ignored the PSI20 futures market since it opened last June 20, were expected to play a more active role in PSI20 futures in 1997 because of the recent increased volatility of the cash market, analysts said.

Carlos Goncalves of Lisbon broker Central Banco de Investimentos said: "I am quite optimistic about the development of the PSI20 futures market this year. The volatility of the cash market will encourage trade in PSI20 futures."
In the five sessions since the start of the New Year, 12,148 contracts traded on Oporto Derivatives Exchange in turnover of 52.4 billion escudos, including 9,463 PSI20 contracts.
